checks.name: Default is a stage task list with all task/tool details collapsed; hidden identifiers and removed features stay absent
Service overview shows two synthetic tool runs; execution completion is separate from criterion satisfaction
Keyboard opens one tool with actual fixture input/output, applicable criterion, example guideline and criterion result
Opening a second tool closes first; passing access check does not overwrite the missing-document task rejection
Opening another task closes previous task and starts with tool details collapsed; approved fixture has matching result
Human record replaces synthetic evidence; optional note survives task collapse and tab changes
Human selection records person/time/verdict, retains reason, and never mutates service verdicts or claims finalized completion
Reset clears local selection and optional notes; help discloses synthetic tools and unimplemented persistence
Default/service overview/tool detail/human note fit1920px and480px without horizontal overflow
Offline mock has no external requests or browser errors
